overview.syncHelp: Open Wish → History in game once a day (you can close it right away): Teyvat.me Capture syncs every banner, then each new wish while the key lasts (~24 h). The game's wish link brings the last six months too. Older than 6 months: import a paimon.moe backup or UIGF file.
overview.emptyBody: Open Wish → History in game once a day (you can close it right away), or import with the game's wish link. Older than 6 months: import a paimon.moe backup or UIGF file.

steps.start: Start the capture app before the game
steps.signIn: Sign in to Teyvat.me in the app
steps.open: Open Wish → History in game: every banner syncs
steps.openTitle: Then each new wish syncs while the game's key lasts (~24 h). The game keeps six months of history.

capture.downloadTitle: Download the capture app (Windows · Linux · macOS · Android)

link.copyFailed: Not copied: select the command and copy it

steps.open: Open Wish → History in game and let it load.
steps.android2: Turn off Wi-Fi and mobile data.
steps.android3: Tap refresh (top right): the page shows an error with some text.
steps.android4: Select all of that text and copy it.
steps.android5: Turn the connection back on, then paste it below.
steps.ios1: Open the Paimon menu → Feedback and let it load.
steps.ios3: Tap the link at the bottom of the reply: it opens in the browser.
steps.ios4: Copy that link and paste it below.
steps.ps1: Open the event mail with a QR code in game.
steps.ps2: Scan the code with your phone and copy the link it opens.
steps.ps3: Paste it below. If it fails, link your PlayStation to a HoYoverse account and use the PC or phone steps.
steps.pcRun: Open PowerShell (Start, type PowerShell) and run:
steps.pcPaste: It copies the link: paste it below.
steps.pcPasteTitle: Teyvat.me Capture's Copy wish URL gives the same link

link.scriptTitle: Reads the game's web cache on this PC, checks the link once with HoYoverse, copies it. Nothing else.
